description.value: The Quilchena Hotel is a historic boutique property built in 1908, set in the Nicola Valley as part of the Douglas Lake Cattle Company's ranch operations. Originally established by the Guichon brothers, the heritage building features period antiques and rooms with pedestal wash-sinks, evoking turn-of-the-century ranching history. A touring cyclist arriving here will find a working ranch landscape, an on-site general store with gas, and a bar and grill, all in a remote and scenic Thompson-Nicola setting.

address.value: 6500 Merritt-Kamloops, BC-5A, Quilchena, BC V0E 2R0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active but operationally changed property: the Quilchena Hotel now operates exclusively as a private, non-staffed (unstaffed) rental facility for groups, which provides explicit negative evidence for staffed bike procedures. The website mentions 'secure parking' as part of the EFT package but does not specify bike storage. On-site amenities (General Store with groceries, one eleven Bar & Grill) are confirmed by the website. The OSM phone number (+1-250-378-2611) conflicts with the website's listed Quilchena Hotel reservation line (1.800.663.4838).
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-378-2611 but the website's current Quilchena Hotel reservation line is 1.800.663.4838; the OSM number most closely matches the General Store (1.250.378.2753) but does not match exactly.

The hotel has transitioned from traditional staffed hotel operation to a private, non-staffed entire-facility rental only (minimum two-night stay), which significantly changes the experience for solo or small-group touring cyclists.
OSM opening_hours tag (Th-Su) suggests limited-day availability, consistent with the resort's current group-rental model.
No specific street address available in either OSM or website for the hotel itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating accommodation in a remote touring region with on-site food and grocery options; the private rental model is unusual but the property is publicly bookable and accessible to cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Entire Facility Rental (EFR) includes 'secure parking' per the website, but this appears to refer to vehicle parking rather than dedicated bike storage. Cyclists booking the full facility would have access to a commercial kitchen and the saloon cold storage.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website lists 'The one eleven Bar & Grill' as a resort amenity on the same property

Nearby grocery.detail: Website confirms the on-site 'Quilchena General Store' (since 1912) carries groceries, gifts, and has gas pumps

Staff know the bike procedure.detail: Website explicitly states the facility operates as an 'un-staffed & user ready facility' and 'NON STAFFED RENTAL' — no staff are present to direct or assist with bikes
